appUpdate.title: Application
appUpdate.forceUpdateHint: If the app seems stuck on an old version despite the update banner (common on iOS, which rarely wakes up the service worker on its own), this button forces a full cache clear and reloads the app.

twoFactorEnroll.title: Enable 2FA
twoFactorEnroll.scanInstructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the generated code.

twoFactorDisable.title: Disable 2FA
twoFactorDisable.confirmInstructions: Confirm your password and a code from your authenticator app.

accessTokens.title: Access tokens
accessTokens.description: Lets you sign in from another device without a password, via "Sign in with token" on the login screen. Reserved for trusted devices already on the tailnet.
accessTokens.createdFor: Token created for "{{label}}" — copy it now, it won't be shown again:
accessTokens.revokeDescription: Device "{{label}}" will no longer be able to sign in with this token.

gdriveConfig.title: Google Drive configuration
gdriveConfig.clientSecretPlaceholderSet: Leave empty to keep the current one
gdriveConfig.rootFolderLabel: Drive root folder ID (created manually in your Drive)
gdriveConfig.savedMessage: Saved to .env — restart the service (sudo systemctl restart pwa-admin) to apply.

gdriveConnection.title: Google Drive
gdriveConnection.disconnectDescription: Jobs targeting "gdrive" will fail until re-authorized.
gdriveConnection.testUploadSuccess: Test file successfully uploaded to Google Drive.
gdriveConnection.authWindowInstructions: A Google window has opened. Sign in, authorize access, then paste the code shown below.
